arguments.body: Dear Ruth, we have received the Breathing Space notification (ref HMA-55102) for Mr Reyes, Flat 3, 8 Kingsland Road, starting 01/10/2026. We have paused all arrears contact and enforcement and will deal with you on the debt. Mr Reyes has emailed offering £100 a month on top of rent from November. We have not accepted or declined this; it has gone to our team and the landlord for a decision, which we will send to you. Please confirm the end date of the breathing space. Kind regards, Mare & Co Lettings

We will now deal with your debt adviser, Ruth Okoye, about the arrears, so you won't get arrears chasers from us. We haven't accepted or declined your £100 a month offer yet. It needs a decision from the landlord and our team, and we will reply through Ruth. Your current rent still needs paying, and repairs carry on as normal. Kind regards, Mare & Co Lettings
